Counsel for Applicant :- Gulam Mustafa Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.570 of 2023, under Section 452, 376, 341, 323,
354A, 504, 506 IPC, P.S. Ganga Ghat, District Unnao.
3. In terms of the FIR lodged against the applicant it was alleged by the informant that the applicant used to pressurize her to marry him and threats were also issued to the father of the informant.

It was stated that on 19.08.2023 at about 09.30 pm, the applicant came alongwith her mother and sister and started hurling abuses and when confronted, he inappropriately touched her and also Rajeev Kumar Singh @ R.K. Singh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ...

1 administered a slap on her.
A similar statement was recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C.

However,
while recording the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim stated that he inappropriately touched her and a finger was also inserted in the private parts of the informant/victim.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant argues that there is a huge variance in the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. and no medical was done to support the said allegation.

He further argues that earlier also, an FIR was lodged at the instance of the informant under Section 323, 504, 506 IPC on 26.08.2023 being FIR No.499 of 2023 which is contained in Annexure - 5 and as a sequel to the said FIR, the present FIR has been lodged.
5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
6.
Considering the submissions made at the Bar, the tentative age of the victim is around 21 years,

the FIR and the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., did not disclose any allegation for the commission of an offence under Section 376 IPC, however, the version was improved in the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C.

The allegation under Section 164 Cr.P.C. is prima-facie not creditworthy as it was stated that the applicant had come alongwith his mother and sister who were present; furthermore, there is no medical to corroborate the said allegation.

7. Considering the aforesaid facts coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history except for the offences registered through FIR No.499 of 2023, the applicant who is in custody since 23.11.2023 is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant Rajeev Kumar Singh @ R.K. Singh be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
